intended_object: Auxiliary idempotent e_i ∈ R corresponding (through Mathlib's bijection between idempotents and clopens of Spec R) to the clopen set {p | i < f p}, for a locally constant rank function f and i < rankBound f. It is used only to build the explicit module ⊕_i (e_i), which realizes a given locally constant rank function (see the docstring and the uses in `rankModule` and `ofLocallyConstantRank`).
explanation: The body applies the inverse of `PrimeSpectrum.isIdempotentElemEquivClopens` to the threshold clopen set {p | i < f p}. The index i ranges over `Fin (rankBound f)`, and `rankBound` is an ad hoc upper bound on the values of f. The definition is correct for its purpose: the lemma `rankIdempotent_notMem_iff` shows that e_i lies outside p exactly when i < f p. But it is a step inside a proof, namely the construction of a finitely generated projective module with a prescribed locally constant rank function, as the sum of the ideals (e_i). It is not a standard notion from the literature. Its dependence on the artificial bound `rankBound` and on the threshold indexing shows that it is an implementation detail rather than a mathematical object in its own right.
